summary: Israeli forces demolished a 1.5-kilometer tunnel in northern Gaza as part of ongoing underground infrastructure clearance. A senior Houthi commander was killed in Bab al-Mandeb clashes while Yemeni government forces captured key coastal areas. Trump warned Iran of imminent 'easy or hard' resolution while Turkey plans military deployment to Saudi Arabia to protect oil infrastructure.
key_points: IDF destroyed 1.5 km tunnel in northern Gaza using Northern Brigade and Division 99 engineering forces. (Source: @New_security8200/204122)
Senior Houthi commander Abu Nasr al-Shaif killed in Bab al-Mandeb clashes. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/82042)
Yemeni government forces captured Dhubab, Bab al-Mandeb, and Mokha from Houthis but commercial shipping remains unsafe. (Source: @shin_persian/10826)
Trump stated on Iran: 'Must finish this. Decide if easy or hard way. Very soon you'll find out how.' (Source: @New_security8200/204127)
Turkey plans military deployment to Saudi Arabia including advanced equipment and special forces to protect East-West oil pipeline. (Source: @SharghDaily/187880)
Iran building several earth-observation satellites with one-meter imaging resolution. (Source: @presstv/209750)
Israeli SIGINT aircraft (GLF5 Nachshon Shavit) conducted electronic reconnaissance over Palestine. (Source: @redlinkleb/46808)
Fires reported at oil refineries in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. (Source: @naya_foriraq/92758)

sections.executive_summary: Israeli forces demolished a 1.5-kilometer tunnel in northern Gaza as part of ongoing underground infrastructure clearance. A senior Houthi commander was killed in Bab al-Mandeb clashes while Yemeni government forces captured key coastal areas. Trump warned Iran of imminent 'easy or hard' resolution while Turkey plans military deployment to Saudi Arabia to protect oil infrastructure.

points: Iran is building several earth-observation satellites with one-meter imaging resolution, according to its space agency chief. (Source: @presstv/209750)

Israel attacked a complex on March 3, 2026, destroying buildings and likely underground infrastructure; satellite imagery shows renewed vehicle movement after extensive cleanup. (Source: @N12chat/228746)
Trump warned Iran that the US must 'finish this' and will decide between 'the easy way or the hard way,' with details coming 'very soon.' (Source: @New_security8200/204127)
An Iraqi analyst stated Iran's military victories and Iraqi resistance pressure forced US withdrawal from Iraq. (Source: @presstv/209754)

Ten American countries condemned Iran's 'terrorist activities' in the Western Hemisphere, citing lethal plots, illegal financing, political interference, and foreign infiltration. (Source: @VahidOnline/78637)
Southern Command chief Maj. Gen. Yaniv Asor warned Hamas that any attack on IDF soldiers or Negev residents will be met with a 'sharp and powerful response.' (Source: @New_security8200/204126)
Over 1,200 air crew members from countries without diplomatic relations with Israel, including Lebanon, Syria, Oman, and Iran, entered Israel this year. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94519)
Israel's National Security Council warned of potential attacks against Israelis and Jews abroad. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94520)
An Israeli GLF5 SIGINT aircraft (Nachshon Shavit, registration 679) conducted electronic reconnaissance over Palestine at 17,950 ft. (Source: @redlinkleb/46808)

IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir, Police Commissioner Danny Levy, and Shin Bet head David Zini held a joint multi-arena assessment for the sensitive upcoming weeks. (Source: @idf_telegram/25298)

IDF combat engineers demolished a 1.5-kilometer tunnel in northern Gaza as part of ongoing efforts to clear Hamas underground infrastructure in the Israeli-held area. (Source: @New_security8200/204122)
The tunnel was destroyed by the Northern Brigade under Division 99 and Southern Command engineering forces operating east of the 'yellow line.' (Source: @manniefabian/59324)
The tunnel had been partially treated during previous IDF operations and was rediscovered after the yellow line was expanded. (Source: @almogboker78/18365)
IDF forces continue to operate in northern Gaza according to the ceasefire framework to remove immediate threats. (Source: @New_security8200/204122)
Artillery shelling reported in Nabatieh al-Fawqa in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/46814)
Fighter jet activity reported over western sector, Beqaa, and Baalbek-Hermel regions. (Source: @redlinkleb/46818, @redlinkleb/46824, @redlinkleb/46827)
Ecuador and Argentina designated Hezbollah as a terrorist organization; Argentina also listed IRGC Quds Force. (Source: @VahidOnline/78637)
Chinese refineries increased purchases of Iraqi and Qatari crude oil due to reduced Iranian oil supply. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/82034)
Iran's military victories and Iraqi resistance pressure accelerated US withdrawal from Iraq, per Iraqi analyst. (Source: @presstv/209754)

Yemeni government forces backed by Saudi-led coalition captured Dhubab, Bab al-Mandeb, and Mokha from Houthis, but commercial shipping safety unchanged since October 5 offensive. (Source: @shin_persian/10826)
Senior Houthi commander Abu Nasr al-Shaif killed in Bab al-Mandeb clashes. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/82042)
Yemeni armed forces' Third Military Region artillery targeted a Houthi military vehicle on the southern Marib front. (Source: @shin_persian/10827)
Yemeni media released images of drone operations targeting Saudi-backed forces on multiple fronts. (Source: @presstv/209745)
Fires and smoke columns observed at oil refineries in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. (Source: @naya_foriraq/92758)
Turkey plans to deploy advanced military equipment, technicians, and possibly fighter jets and special forces to Saudi Arabia to protect the East-West oil pipeline. (Source: @SharghDaily/187880)
Brent crude fell 2.5% to $97 per barrel. (Source: @SharghDaily/187878)

key_developments: IDF demolished a 1.5-kilometer tunnel in northern Gaza using Northern Brigade and Division 99 engineering forces, continuing underground infrastructure clearance east of the yellow line. (Source: @New_security8200/204122)
Houthi senior commander Abu Nasr al-Shaif killed in Bab al-Mandeb clashes as Yemeni government forces captured key coastal areas including Dhubab and Mokha. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/82042)
Trump declared on Iran: 'Must finish this. Decide if easy or hard way. Very soon you'll find out how,' signaling imminent escalation. (Source: @New_security8200/204127)
Turkey preparing military deployment to Saudi Arabia including advanced equipment, technicians, and potential fighter jets to protect East-West oil pipeline. (Source: @SharghDaily/187880)
Iran building multiple earth-observation satellites with one-meter resolution, enhancing space-based intelligence capabilities. (Source: @presstv/209750)
Israeli SIGINT aircraft (GLF5 Nachshon Shavit) conducted electronic reconnaissance over Palestine at 17,950 feet. (Source: @redlinkleb/46808)
Fires erupted at oil refineries in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, with widespread smoke columns observed. (Source: @naya_foriraq/92758)
